scenario: A road accident leaves the earning member unable to work for 10 months.
notes: Months 1-3 (rider waiting): 3 x 70k = 2.1L from 3L savings. Months 4-10: rider 60k vs 70k outgo, shortfall 7 x 10k = 70k. Total 2.8L <= 3L. Trap: Flagger ignoring Clause 5.

scenario: The earning member's employment is terminated and they have no income for 8 months.
notes: Need 8 x 70k = 5.6L. Liquid 3L; with FD (1.98L net) 4.98L. Still short. Trap: rider excludes termination (5.5).
1 Cr to nominee clears 40L loan with 60L left.

scenario: A child is hospitalised for 5 days for pneumonia; total bill Rs 4,00,000 in a room costing Rs 8,000 per day.
notes: Within 10L sum insured, room under 10k cap. Not pre-existing.

scenario: A serious illness (not an accident) keeps the earning member off work with no salary for 9 months.
notes: Need 9 x 70k = 6.3L > 4.98L even with FD. Rider excludes illness; health policy excludes income loss.

scenario: Hospitalisation for a complication of the person's pre-existing diabetes; total bill Rs 8,00,000.
notes: 15L sum insured looks ample, but PED waiting is 36 months and coverage is only 18 months, so 0 paid. Savings 2L, PPF locked.

scenario: A road accident needs surgery; bill Rs 9,00,000 (of which Rs 1,00,000 is medicines), in a premium room costing Rs 25,000 per day.
notes: Accident covered from day one, but proportionate deduction 15k/25k = 0.6 on 8L non-medicine = 4.8L + 1L medicines = 5.8L paid. Shortfall 3.2L > 2L savings.
75L to nominee, no loans, rent liability ends. ~12 years of household expenses.

scenario: The consultant loses their main clients and has no income for 6 months.
notes: Need 6 x 50k = 3L, liquid 2L, PPF locked until 2031.

scenario: An accident leaves the person unable to work for 5 months; hospital bills are small and fully covered.
notes: Need 5 x 50k = 2.5L > 2L. Trap: accident cover in health policy (6.3) does not replace income; no rider.
50L assigned to lender vs 60L loan: 10L shortfall recoverable from heirs, nominee receives nothing.

scenario: The lender reviews whether the borrower complies with the insurance conditions of the home loan.
notes: Required cover >= 60L, actual 50L: an event of default the lender can act on.

scenario: The earning member is laid off and has no income for 12 months.
Emergency appendicitis surgery; bill Rs 2,50,000 in a standard single room.
notes: Within sum insured; standard room 6k under 10k cap.

scenario: An accident leaves the earning member unable to work for 6 months.
notes: Month 1 (30-day wait) 90k from 5L savings; months 2-6 rider 90k matches 90k outgo.
